hero.title:
Scenic Bordeaux

hero.subtitle: A Luxury River Journey Through Bordeaux Wine Country, Saint-Émilion & Médoc
hero.description: A Scenic Bordeaux River Cruise is one of the best ways to explore southwestern France if your ideal luxury vacation revolves around wine, gastronomy, history, countryside, and beautiful French towns. Bordeaux is more than a city  it is the gateway to one of the world's most celebrated wine regions, and a river cruise allows travelers to explore that region without repeatedly changing hotels.
hero.extendedText: Depending on your itinerary, a Scenic Bordeaux sailing can take you along the Garonne, Dordogne, and Gironde estuary, visiting legendary wine villages such as Saint-Émilion, prestigious estates in Médoc, historic fortresses like Blaye, and châteaux in Cadillac. On board, Scenic Space-Ships deliver an all-inclusive luxury experience with private Butler Service, all-weather Sun Lounges, and complimentary Scenic Freechoice excursions and Scenic Enrich private classical experiences.

quickAnswer.title: Is a Scenic Bordeaux River Cruise Worth It? The Quick Answer
quickAnswer.intro: Yes  especially for travelers who love wine, food, French culture, historic towns, and relaxed luxury travel. Bordeaux is one of the strongest European river cruise choices for travelers who want their vacation to revolve around gastronomy and wine rather than visiting as many countries as possible.
quickAnswer.outro: It's especially appealing for wine enthusiasts, food lovers, couples, luxury travelers, first-time river cruisers, art and architecture enthusiasts, French culture travelers, multigenerational groups, and travelers celebrating a special occasion.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose a Scenic Bordeaux River Cruise?
whyChoose.intro: The biggest reason is access. A Bordeaux river cruise allows you to explore several famous wine-producing areas while avoiding the logistical challenge of arranging separate hotels and transportation between each destination. Instead of hotel → car → hotel → train → hotel → excursion, your experience becomes luxury ship → destination → excursion → relaxed evening sailing.
whyChoose.callout: A Bordeaux river cruise can combine Bordeaux, the Garonne River, the Dordogne River, Saint-Émilion, Médoc, French wine estates, historic villages & châteaux, and French cuisine into one seamless trip.
